reason: One additive installation-device issuer beside the existing daemon pairing routes implements the approved account selection, original native-key attestation, explicit device consent and exact committed-outcome reconciliation. It reuses the existing pairing table/channel, device registration digest, session checks and bounded transaction helper. Its nine internal route-facing declarations plus the fixed first-party identity-map helper and one explicitly scoped authentication helper do not change published SDK/protocol exports. Only device challenge, cloud-copy bootstrap and collection log-token opt in to installation credentials; controller/relay/grant/private-account routes do not. No new package or hard gate change.
